title: Mace Windu
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: A grim Jedi that Anakin Skywalker respected as one of the most powerful Jedi in the order, Mace Windu wielded a unique amethyst-bladed Lightsaber. It was with this Lightsaber that the ever-serious Jedi confronted Chancellor Palpatine about his extended rule over the galaxy. Windu sensed a plot to destroy the Jedi, and discovered quickly that this was exactly what the Chancellor had in mind.
